title: The Yan Alliance
summary: Xiao Yan gives Xiao Li the Deep Green Longevity Pill, which holds back the Life Devouring Pill, and tells him to reach Dou Huang within ten years. He then gathers the capital's powers and proposes an alliance in which members serve it first and an Elder's Council decides. Hai Bodong takes the first seat for the Mite'er family, and the Mu Clan, the Nalan Clan and the imperial family join. Fa Ma agrees to bring in the Alchemist Association in return for ten fifth-tier alchemists within a decade. Xiao Yan names it the Yan Alliance and rewards his allies with Fighting Spirit Pills and Mighty Huang Pills, and Medusa reminds him their one-year deal ends in two months. Feeling close to breaking through, Xiao Yan takes Zi Yan and Medusa to the Magical Beast Mountain Range by way of Qingshan Town. There he saves Ka Gang and Ling Er of the Bloody Battle Mercenary Company from the Snake Nest Mercenary Company.
